scenes.heading: Binary Search
scenes.narration: Learn how binary search efficiently finds a value in a sorted list using middle checks and smart range updates.

scenes.heading: Binary Search in Python
scenes.narration: Binary search finds a value in a sorted list by checking the middle element. If it's too low, we search the right half. If too high, we search the left. It repeats until found or exhausted.

steps.narration: Initialize left and right pointers at start and end of sorted list.
Loop while left is less than or equal to right.
Find middle index and compare value to target.
If middle matches target, return index. Else adjust search range.

scenes.heading: How Binary Search Works
scenes.narration: Start with full list. Pick middle element. If it matches, done. If too low, search right half. If too high, search left half. Repeat until found or list ends.

steps.narration: Target is 7, so search right half.
New middle: 8 → not found. Search left half.
